command: set -u; EXPECTED='a2ae55aaf9244ff3222c92a47ad4adc71c07b672'; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; XML='/tmp/tracker-vibration-alarm-accept.xml'; OUT='/tmp/tracker-phase3-alert-s22-signed-vibration-accept-v1'; }; coords(){ python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; }; retry_coords(){ attr=$1; value=$2; tries=${3:-5}; out=''; i=1; while [ $i -le $tries ]; do dump || true; out=$(coords "$attr" "$value" || true); mc=''; i=1; while [ $i -le 6 ]; do mc=$(master_coords || true); [ -n "$mc" ] && break; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 650 500 1800 350; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; test -n "$mc" || exit 32; current=$(master_state || true); echo detection_before_cleanup=$current; if [ "$current" = true ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $mc; sleep 2; fi; if [ "$initial" = true ]; then mc=$(master_coords || true); test -n "$mc" || exit 33; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $mc; sleep 2; fi; final=$(master_state || true); echo detection_final=$final; test "$final" = "$initial" || exit 34; left=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -cE 'NotificationRecord\(.*pkg=io\.blueeye .*tag=TEST' || true); echo test_notification_after_cleanup=$left; test "$left" -eq 0 || exit 35; echo PHASE3_ALERT_S22_VIBRATION_USAGE_ALARM_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
